## Summary

Describe the teacher, student, operator, or contributor outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Docker build or runtime behavior checked when relevant

## Safety and provenance

- [ ] No credentials, student data, session codes, private URLs, logs, databases, or recordings are included.
- [ ] New questions and media have documented, redistribution-compatible provenance.
- [ ] Privacy and accessibility impacts were considered.
